reasoning.text:
[p0 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Fresh level, no synth model. Probe directional actions (up, left) to detect a movable agent/cursor/selection before committing to a goal strategy.

[p1 | acting_agent | action_plan]
ACTION3=rotate central piece, ACTION1=noop. Reset to clean board then map ACTION2(down) and ACTION4(right): determine if they translate the purple piece toward the white slot below or rotate the other way.

[p2 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Up/down=noop, left/right rotate the framed square. Reset to clean board, then probe the two untested actions: ACTION5 (interact/commit, likely win/drop mechanic) and a click on the central purple piece, to learn their semantics.

[p3 | acting_agent | action_plan]
ACTION5 pours purple from the framed box into the white slot below (one press filled top 5 of 10 rows). Press once more to continue filling the slot and watch for reward/level-advance; single step to avoid overshooting into a new level.

[p4 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot is half purple(top)/half white(bottom), the inverse of the TL white-over-purple target. Test ACTION2(down)=gravity to sink purple below white and match TL; single step to read result before overshooting.

[p5 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Goal=fill slot fully purple but pour stalls at half and model finds no plan. Probe the unexplored TR control-panel boxes (purple at 43,4 and white at 37,4) as clickable buttons that may reload/retrigger the dispenser.

[s0 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=1 engine=0 accuracy=100.0

[p6 | acting_agent | action_plan]
TR boxes are dispenser color selectors (clicking white turned dispenser white). Reload purple by clicking purple box (43,4), then ACTION5 pour again to fill the slots remaining (bottom) half with purple, completing the goal.

[s1 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=2 engine=1 accuracy=100.0

[p7 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Pour only fills top half and no-ops when top is purple; model has no bottom-fill mechanic. Rotate dispenser to a diamond (reaches lower) then pour, to test whether a rotated pour deposits purple into the slots bottom half and completes the fill.

[p8 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Rotated pour fills slot bottom diagonally; left-diamond filled bottom-left triangle. Roll to right-leaning diamond (ACTION4 back to home, ACTION4 to right-tilt) then pour to fill the bottom-right, observing how much of the remaining white completes.

[s2 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=3 engine=2 accuracy=100.0

[p9 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Three pour orientations leave a fixed center-bottom wedge. Test whether repeating the right-diamond pour peels the next diagonal inward (filling wedge-right); if so I can alternate diamonds to finish.

[s3 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=4 engine=3 accuracy=100.0

[p10 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Three orientations (0,+-45) cannot fill the center-bottom wedge; the dispenser is a rolling square so likely has steeper states. Rotate ACTION4 past the right-diamond to a steeper orientation, then pour to test if it deposits into the center wedge.

[p11 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Only 3 rotation states exist and they leave a center wedge; current state is a dead end. Reset and pour a left-diamond on an empty slot to learn the true clean diamond deposit shape (previously measured with top pre-filled), to find a fill ordering or reveal a missing mechanic.

[p12 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Reset to empty slot, press DOWN, then POUR: test whether down rotates the dispenser to a vertical/down orientation (visually identical to home) that fills the BOTTOM of the slot -- the exact bottom-center wedge the 3 known pours cannot reach.

[s4 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=5 engine=4 accuracy=100.0

[p13 | acting_agent | action_plan]
NEW GOAL HYPOTHESIS: top-left 10x10 template (rows3-12 cols3-13) shows white-top/purple-bottom. Slot is currently INVERTED (purple-top rows34-38, white-bottom rows39-43). Synth goal (fill all purple) is unproven (score still 0). Test ACTION2=gravity: with purple now in the top half, down should make it FALL to the bottom -> white-top/purple-bottom = match template. Earlier down was no-op only because slot was empty.

[p14 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Gravity(down) confirmed inert in all contexts. Purple is only ever deposited in UPPER regions by the 3 pours, so the bottom-center wedge is unreachable by pouring. Test the only remaining untested deposit mechanic: direct CLICK-PAINT. Purple loaded, bottom half white -- click two bottom-center white cells (31,41),(33,42); if they turn purple, paint mechanic confirmed and I can fill any cell directly.

[p15 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Goal=match 10x10 template (top-half WHITE, bottom-half PURPLE); slot is currently inverted. Both goal-readings are blocked because I have never seen purple->white repaint or bottom-fill. FOUNDATIONAL TEST: click WHITE swatch (36,4) to load white, then POUR(5) onto the purple top half. If top turns white -> pour REPLACES color (not just fills white) and swatch-select works -> puzzle unlocks. If no-op -> pour only fills white cells, confirming mechanic gap to flag.

[p16 | acting_agent | action_plan]
CONFIRMED: swatch-click sets dispenser color; pour REPLACES target region (home=top half) with selected color. Slot now all white. GOAL=template top-white/bottom-purple, so I need bottom half (rows39-43) purple. Untested: ACTION1(up) as a reorientation. Plan: select PURPLE (click 43,4), ACTION1(up) to try to point dispenser at the BOTTOM half, then POUR. If up reorients down-fill -> bottom turns purple, top stays white -> MATCHES TEMPLATE -> reward. If up inert, pour fills top purple and I learn up is inert.

[s5 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=6 engine=5 accuracy=100.0

[p17 | acting_agent | action_plan]
up(1) confirmed inert (both verticals inert). Only home/left-diamond/right-diamond orientations found, none fill bottom. But my -only 3 states- belief predates the gravity/replace corrections and may be wrong. Test rotation PINWHEEL: reset (clean white slot, purple selected), rotate LEFT twice, pour. If 2 lefts reaches a NEW lower fill region (vs single-left upper-left triangle) -> continuous 45deg rotation exists and lower/bottom fills are reachable -> path to template. If identical to single-left -> pinwheel disproven.

[p18 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Pinwheel DISPROVEN: 2nd left = no-op, only 3 pour regions exist; bottom-center wedge (rows40-43 center) is covered by NONE -> can never be purple -> template unreachable by dispenser alone. Missing mechanic must be a region I have never touched: the TOP-LEFT BOX (white-top/purple-bottom, framed, rows3-12 cols3-12). Click its purple half (7,10) and white half (7,5) to test if it is interactive (a hidden control) vs purely a goal display.

[p19 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Synth goal now = slot must match legend (white top rows34-38, purple bottom rows39-43), ALL 100 cells incl. wedge. Synth pour footprints (square=top half, dl/dr=upper triangles) cover everything EXCEPT bottom-center wedge -> model cannot fill it -> a mechanic is missing. Slot fills look like TILTED-LIQUID surfaces; synth treats pours as static paint. Test liquid-redistribution: reset, pour purple (top half), then rotate dl (3) and back to square (4). If the slot purple MOVES/flows when the dispenser tilts (synth predicts no slot change on rotation), liquid conservation is the missing mechanic and could reach the wedge.

[p20 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Confirmed: rotation does NOT redistribute slot liquid (slot paint is static); synth model accurate; 3 pour footprints leave the 20-cell bottom-center wedge permanently white -> legend match impossible by mapped mechanics. Wedge NEVER purple in any logged frame. Untested interaction: clicking the DISPENSER BODY itself (only swatches/slot/legend clicked so far). Test: reset (clean white slot), click dispenser center (31,28) -- may reveal a hidden downward pose -- then pour. If pour now fills the BOTTOM of the slot, clicking the dispenser is the missing mechanic.

[p21 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Sub-agent confirmed no unmodeled mechanic in code/buffer; wedge never purple. But my impossibility proof assumes pour footprints are state-INDEPENDENT, never verified for sequential diagonal pours on the real env (buffer never did dl-then-dr). Test: from square pose (purple loaded) rotate dl, pour (upper-left tri), rotate to dr (4,4), pour (upper-right tri). Then read the bottom-center wedge (rows40-43 center). If real-env sequential pours fill the wedge (footprint extends when far triangle pre-filled), goal is solvable; if wedge stays white, impossibility is empirically confirmed and I escalate to synth.

[p22 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Fresh initial slot is all-white (verified from first frame), so the 20-cell bottom-center wedge (r40:c31-32,r41:c30-33,r42:c29-34,r43:c28-35) starts WHITE and is covered by NONE of the 3 pour footprints (square=rows34-38, dl=r+c<=70, dr=c>=r-7); legend requires it PURPLE (legend rows9-12=F verified). So legend-exact match is unreachable by mapped mechanics. Decisive test: reach the CLOSEST reachable state to the legend and observe. Currently top rows34-39 all purple, bottom purple-except-wedge, pose=dr, purple loaded. Click white swatch(37,4) to select white; ACTION3 rolls dr->square; ACTION5 pours white into square footprint -> rows34-38 become white, row39 stays purple, rows40-43 stay purple-except-wedge = maximally legend-matching reachable state. TWO purposes: (1) if real reward is lenient/ignores the wedge (container wall/background), this WINS; (2) observe square pours REAL footprint against the purple bottom -- if white appears below row38 or in the wedge, the synth mismodeled square (maybe a straight-down stream) and that is the path to fill the wedge.

[p23 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Reward did NOT fire at the closest-to-legend state (slot rows34-38 white, row39 purple, rows40-43 purple-except-wedge; SCORE still 0), so the bottom-center 20-cell wedge MUST be purple -- not don't-care. No known pose fills it. BUT divergence frames prove the synth dispenser/pose model is incomplete (dispenser repositions per pose, rotating AROUND the slot: dl=upper-left, square=top, dr=upper-right). Action history shows ACTION3(left) clamps at dl after 1 step (step38 Nothing changed), but ACTION4(right) was NEVER pressed while already at dr -- the beyond-dr region is UNEXPLORED. Continuing the rotation rightward past dr should carry the dispenser toward the right/bottom side of the slot, where a pour could finally reach the bottom-center wedge. Current pose=square. ACTION4 x3: square->dr->(beyond?)->(beyond?). Pure rotation, does not touch the slot (top stays white, bottom purple-except-wedge). Observe new dispenser positions/pose markers; if a 4th+ pose exists, next call load purple and pour into the wedge.

[s6 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=7 engine=6 accuracy=100.0

[p24 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Exhaustive mapping shows 3 poses only; their pour footprints (square=rows34-38, dl/dr triangles) never cover the 20-cell center-bottom wedge, so the legend-exact match (wedge=purple) is unreachable -- confirmed by step56 reaching the closest state with real reward 0. Flagged synth. PROBE: the white triangular wedge is now a VISUALLY DISTINCT region (white triangle inside purple) that I have never clicked in this form (earlier wedge clicks were on a uniform slot). Per enumerate-every-region: select purple (swatch x43,y4) then click two clearly-white wedge cells (31,43)&(29,42) to test if it is a clickable fill-target. If clicks paint purple -> path to fill wedge; if no-op -> strong evidence the synth goal/transition model is wrong and I escalate to alternate-goal tests next call.

[p25 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Wedge confirmed unfillable by pours (3 poses only; footprints square=rows34-38, dl/dr triangles miss the 20-cell center-bottom wedge) and NOT clickable (step61/62 no-op on the comp_size=20 white object). Purple selected, pose=dr. GENUINE GAP: ACTION1/ACTION2 were only ever issued in the square/initial pose (steps 0,3,9,26,28,34, all DIFF=1) -- NEVER in a tilted dl/dr pose. The divergence frames already proved the synth mis-modeled dispenser movement, so its inert-ACTION1/2 claim in tilted poses is unverified in the real env. Probe ACTION2(down) then ACTION1(up) while in dr pose, watching the DISPENSER body: if either flips/repositions it (DIFF>1 on dispenser cells), that may open a downward/center pour that can finally fill the wedge. Pure probe, slot untouched. If both inert, the legend-exact goal is confirmed unreachable and I escalate to alternate-goal tests / sub-agent deep dive.

[p26 | acting_agent | action_plan]
BREAKTHROUGH from divergence: ACTION1/ACTION2 are a SECOND rotation axis the synth never modeled. step63 ACTION2 rotated the dr dispenser to a right-side UPRIGHT VERTICAL pose (rows33-44 cols38-46, aligned beside the slot); step64 ACTION1 reverted to dr. So the dispenser ORBITS the slot, far more poses than dl/square/dr. square(12 o-clock) pours the TOP band rows34-38; by symmetry a BOTTOM(6 o-clock) pose should pour the BOTTOM band rows39-43, which would finally fill the 20-cell center-bottom wedge that no top-arc pose can reach. Current pose=dr, purple loaded. Rotate clockwise via ACTION2 x3 (dr->right-vertical->bottom-right?->bottom?) PURELY to map the new poses and find one positioned at/below the slot bottom. Slot untouched by rotation. Next call: once the bottom/center-filling pose is identified, pour purple (ACTION5) into the wedge to complete top-white/bottom-purple = legend match.

[s7 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=8 engine=7 accuracy=100.0

[p27 | acting_agent | action_plan]
ACTION2 orbit mapped: dr->right-vertical->BOTTOM-RIGHT tilted pose (current, dispenser rows42-56 cols38-50 below-right of slot); step67 ACTION2 clamped here. This is a NEW pour position the synth never modeled. Pattern: pour fills the slot region nearest the dispenser (dl->upper-left tri, square->top band, dr->upper-right tri). So this bottom-right pose should pour the LOWER-RIGHT region of the slot, likely covering the right half of the 20-cell center-bottom wedge that no top-arc pose can reach. Purple is loaded; top-white stays safe (pours hit the near/bottom region, not the top). POUR (ACTION5) and observe the exact footprint: if it fills wedge cells, I have the mechanic -- then reach the symmetric bottom-LEFT pose (via dl + ACTION1/2) to fill the rest, completing bottom-purple = legend match.

[s8 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=9 engine=8 accuracy=100.0

[p28 | acting_agent | action_plan]
WEDGE SOLVED: bottom-right pose pour filled the lower-right triangle -> rows39-43 now ALL purple (incl former wedge). Side effect: a purple triangle bled into the right of top rows34-38. Goal = rows34-38 white, rows39-43 purple (legend). Just need to re-whiten the top band. square pose pours exactly rows34-38 (verified steps6/56), leaving rows39-43 untouched=purple. Navigate bottom-right ->[1] right-vertical ->[1] dr ->[3] square; click white swatch(37,4) to load white; ACTION5 pours white across rows34-38 -> slot = top-white/bottom-purple = exact legend match -> reward should fire.

[p29 | acting_agent | action_plan]
LEVEL 1 SOLVED (reward 1.0 step73, score now 1). LEVEL 2: legend is a 3-color anti-diagonal split (slot-local i=row-34,j=col-27): PURPLE A={i<=4 & i+j<=8}, WHITE B={i>=5 & i+j<=8}, ORANGE C={i+j>=9}. New 3rd color orange (swatch x46,y4; purple x40; white x34). Slot starts ALL WHITE = the B color, so leave B untouched. Dispenser=square pose, purple loaded. Plan: square-pose purple pour fills {i<=4} (rows34-38): sets A purple correctly, over-paints only the top-right corner {i<=4,i+j>=9} which I will re-orange later, and does NOT touch B (i>=5). Confident, safe (B stays white). Pour now and CONFIRM square footprint still = rows34-38 on this level; then next: select orange + find a clean {i+j>=9} lower-right-triangle pose to finish C.

[s9 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=10 engine=9 accuracy=100.0

[p30 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 slot now purple {i<=4}, white {i>=5} after square purple pour (step74). Target legend: purple {i<=4 & i+j<=8}, white {i>=5 & i+j<=8}, orange {i+j>=9}. KEY: re-derived bottom-right pose footprint from L1 step68 DIFF = EXACTLY {i+j>=9} (clean anti-diagonal; all 30 changed cells had i+j>=9; earlier OR-i>=5 note was wrong). So: select orange (click swatch x46,y4), then rotate square->dr (A4) -> right-vertical (A2) -> bottom-right clamp (A2), then pour A5 to set {i+j>=9} orange. This leaves purple top-left and white lower-left untouched -> exact legend match -> reward. If pose path off, slot will show + I RESET.

[p31 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 entered. Probe NEW mechanic: does clicking a slot cell paint it? Click two purple-target slot cells (0,0)=(27,34) and (2,9)=(36,36), both target purple with purple loaded so harmless if it paints. Model says clicks only hit swatches (no-op on slot) but model does not know the new box above the dispenser. If DIFF shows these cells turn purple => click-to-paint exists (needed for the orange rect cols3-6 which no pour footprint can isolate). If Nothing changed, next probe the small box itself.

[s10 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=11 engine=10 accuracy=100.0

[p32 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot clicks were no-ops (comp_size=100, click-to-paint ruled out). Probe the NEW small second dispenser above the main one (rows18-22 cols29-34, white spout pointing up): click its purple body (31,21) and its white spout (32,19) to see if it is selectable/activatable. This box is new to L3 and is the likely fine-paint mechanic for the orange rectangle {i<=2,3<=j<=6} which no pour footprint can isolate.

[p33 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Select RED swatch, roll square->dr->r, pour red on right-half {j>=5}. First of 4 pours building the L3 legend; verify r-pour footprint (unobserved in real env) before continuing with GREEN l, PURPLE dl, ORANGE stamp.

[s11 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=12 engine=11 accuracy=100.0

[s12 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=13 engine=12 accuracy=100.0

[p34 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3: color14 right-half already poured. Select color8 (x53), navigate r->dr->square->dl->l (1,3,3,2; left descent dl->l is unobserved-verify), then pour color8 into l{j<=4}. Next: dl purple, orange stamp.

[s13 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=14 engine=12 accuracy=97.7

[p35 | acting_agent | action_plan]
l-pour red done (left half). Roll l->dl (A1), select purple, pour purple into dl{i+j<=9} (sim=legend except orange rect), then roll dl->square (A4) to restore the stamp box. Next call: select orange + stamp click to win.

[s14 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=15 engine=13 accuracy=100.0

[p36 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot matches legend except the 12-cell orange rect. Select orange (x35,y4) to recolor the stamp box, then click the stamp box (x31,y21) to deposit orange into i0-2,j3-6 -> slot==legend (sim 0-diff). Expect L3 win.

[p37 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: blue rect {i3-6,j0-2} provably needs the stamp (no pour gives a horizontal i=3/i=7 band). Probe stamp deposit rule: select blue (x41,y4) then click stamp box (x31,y21) in square pose. Observe where blue lands -> reveals whether stamp footprint is fixed slot-top, legend-interior-rect, or pose-relative.

[s15 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=16 engine=14 accuracy=100.0

[p38 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Stamp in square pose deposits at fixed {i0-2,j3-6} (box-anchored), wrong for L4 blue rect {i3-6,j0-2}. Box travels with dispenser; navigate square->dl->l (3,2) so box moves to slot left edge, then test-stamp blue (already selected) at predicted left box loc x13,y38 to learn the l-pose deposit footprint.

[p39 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4: blue rect already placed at {i3-6,j0-2} by step104 l-stamp. Select orange and navigate l->r to begin right-half fill (orange r-pour next). Win plan: orange r, purple br, yellow l, re-stamp blue l.

[s16 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=17 engine=15 accuracy=100.0

[p40 | acting_agent | action_plan]
At r-pose orange-selected: pour orange r{j>=5} (right half orange), roll r->br (ACTION2), select purple, pour purple br{i+j>=9} -> right half = orange upper / purple lower-right (matches legend). Yellow l-pour + blue re-stamp next.

[p41 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Right half exact. Nav br->l [1,1,3,3,2], select yellow, pour l{j<=4} to fill entire left half yellow (overwrites stray blue/purple). Final step next call: select blue + re-stamp at l x13y38 to restore blue rect {i3-6,j0-2} -> slot==legend, win.

[p42 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot complete except blue rect {i3-6,j0-2} (currently yellow). Select blue swatch then stamp at l-pose box (x13,y38) which deposits {i3-6,j0-2} (verified step104) -> slot==legend, L4 win.

[p43 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 start. Decoded legend: C=br{i+j>=9}, E=bl{j<=i,i+j<=8}, 8=square-stamp rect{i0-2,j3-6}, 9=remaining. Layer plan dl(9)<bl(E)<br(C)<stamp(8). Chunk1: select color9, roll square->dl, pour 9 base over {i+j<=9}.

[s17 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=18 engine=16 accuracy=100.0

[p44 | acting_agent | action_plan]
9 base {i+j<=9} done at dl. Nav dl->l->bl [2,2], select E(14) x47, pour bl{j<=i} (VERIFY this unobserved SW footprint). E should remain at {j<=i,i+j<=8} after later br C pour.

[p45 | acting_agent | action_plan]
bl verified ({j<=i}=E). Nav bl->br [1,1,4,4,2,2] (up left, across top, down right), select C(12), pour br{i+j>=9}. Then square stamp 8 next chunk for the rect -> legend match.

[p46 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot==legend except 8-rect {i0-2,j3-6}. Nav br->square [1,1,3], select color8 x53, square-stamp x31y21 deposits box-cols at slot-top = {i0-2,j3-6} (verified L3/L4) -> L5 win.

[p47 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 slot starts all-white; begin solution: select green, roll square->dr->r, pour green into right half (j>=5). First L6 action — verify pour footprint and roll table before committing the full layered plan.

[s18 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=19 engine=17 accuracy=100.0

[p48 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Green r-pour confirmed (j>=5). Now select red, roll r->dr->square->dl, pour red into dl footprint (i+j<=9) as the base layer; verify dl footprint before stamps.

[p49 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Base layer (red/green/white) matches target exactly. Now select blue and roll dl->l to expose the stamp box on the left edge; observe box coords next before stamping the blue rect.

[p50 | acting_agent | action_plan]
l pose, blue loaded, stamp box on left edge cols18-24. Click box center (21,38) to deposit blue rect; verify it lands on slot {i3-6,j0-2} before the final purple square-stamp.

[p51 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Stamp trigger is the small dispenser die (comp_size=12), not the big box. Click die at (14,38) to deposit blue rect {i3-6,j0-2}; verify before final purple square-stamp.

[p52 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot matches target except purple rect {i0-2,j3-6}. Select purple, roll l->dl->square, click square-pose die (31,21) to stamp the top-centre purple rect -> should complete L6.

[s19 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=20 engine=18 accuracy=100.0
